title: Reviewing a design together
idea: A design review is a short session where peers test your design against its requirements and leave specific, actionable comments.
points: The author states the requirements first, then walks one use case end to end.
Reviewers ask what happens when a requirement changes, and which class must change.
Every comment names a class, a problem and a suggested next step.

hero.title: Comments that help, and those that do not

right.title: Actionable
items: Elevator picks cars in a long if-else; extract a DispatchStrategy.
A new fee type edits Ticket; move pricing behind an interface.
Two threads can book seat 4; lock per show.
R3 has no check; add one for a full lot.

hero.verdict: A useful comment points at a class, a risk and a fix.

takeaway: Review against requirements, and make every comment specific and actionable.

starters: How do I respond when a reviewer disagrees with my design?
What questions should I ask when reviewing someone else's design?
How long should a design review take?
